Privacy Policy:
US Privacy Policy - US-2026-11-03
Controller: Adriana Hernandez, Mexico; no US legal entity established. Contact: support@auricrx.com.mx.
We process account identifiers, user-entered medications, supplements, herbs, reminders, appointments, documents, chat messages, and preferences to provide requested features. Firebase/Google supplies authentication; Render and Neon host and synchronize app data; OpenAI processes chat you send. Apple/Google may process account or billing information when those services are used; store purchases are not yet integrated.
We do not sell health data, use targeted ads, or send health data to analytics. Health Connect/HealthKit readings remain on the device and must not be sent to OpenAI, advertising, or iCloud. Optional device location permissions are controlled in system settings. US facility geofencing and weather services are disabled pending review.
Data may be processed in the US and Mexico. Account and health records remain until account deletion or a documented retention requirement applies. Account deletion removes per-user application rows and the Firebase identity; processor backup retention and any required legal retention must be confirmed by the owner. Do not assume immediate removal from processor backups. We do not promise a deletion schedule that has not been verified.
Use Settings > Privacy to withdraw consent or delete your account. Request access, correction, deletion, or an appeal through the authenticated account and the contact above; do not email medical documents or identity copies. We verify identity and respond within applicable legal deadlines. Withdrawal stops future health processing; deleting existing records requires account deletion.
Access controls and authenticated transport protect data, but cannot guarantee absolute security. We investigate unauthorized acquisition or disclosure, including unauthorized processor disclosures, under our FTC Health Breach Notification Rule plan. Required notices identify recipients and are issued without unreasonable delay, no later than 60 days after discovery.
Adults 18+ only. Changes to purposes or recipients require an updated notice and new express consent before new sharing.
Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy:
Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy - US-2026-11-03
This separate notice covers consumers including Washington, Nevada, and Connecticut. Controller: Adriana Hernandez, Mexico; contact support@auricrx.com.mx.
Categories: user-entered medications, supplements, herbs, health profiles, symptoms, reminders, appointments, documents, and chat content. Sources: you, your uploaded documents, and public reference services you query. Optional wearable data is kept on your device. Drug reference searches may reveal health interests.
Purposes: organize your information, reminders, reference lookup, requested chat, and synchronization. We ask separately before health-data collection and before processor sharing. The cloud beta requires both to enable health features.
Recipients: Firebase/Google for authentication, Render and Neon for hosting/sync, OpenAI for chat you choose to send. Reference queries go through Render to NLM RxNorm, DailyMed, FDA, CMS Medicaid NADAC, or CMS NPPES as selected; we send the search terms needed, not your complete health profile. External links open the recipient site under its own privacy terms.
No sale of consumer health data, targeted ads, or facility geofencing. No Health Connect/HealthKit data sent to OpenAI, ads, or iCloud.
Access, correction, deletion, consent withdrawal, and appeals: use Settings > Privacy and authenticated account deletion, or contact the controller. We verify account ownership, respond within applicable statutory deadlines, and provide a reason and appeal route for denied requests. Withdraw collection and sharing separately in Settings; withdrawing either stops cloud health features. Existing records can be removed with account deletion; processor backup retention requires owner verification. New sharing requires new express consent.
